how: Synthesized: selecting a Python dataclass in VS Code (Dark Modern theme) and pressing Cmd+C.
notes:
SYNTHESIZED. VS Code is Electron and sets its data in the copy event through DataTransfer, so on the macOS pasteboard Chromium stores the custom "vscode-editor-data" JSON inside the pickled org.chromium.web-custom-data entry (included here, real binary pickle layout: uint32 size, uint32 count, then UTF-16 type/data string pairs). The same JSON is also stored as a separate "vscode-editor-data" representation so tests can read it directly; a real macOS pasteboard would NOT have that top-level type. HTML is a
with the editor font and one
per line, tokens as , blank lines as

, plus Chrome's prefix; colors depend on the active theme. Note "mode" tells you the language of the copied text; isFromEmptySelection is true when a line was copied with no selection.
